_comment: Per-project SWE.4 configuration. Every project-specific value lives here, never in the scripts. Copy, then edit for your project - do not reuse the OXY names below.
_comment_asil: Drives the structural coverage targets below. Set the highest ASIL of the units under test; QM keeps MC/DC disabled.
_comment_ids: Case ids are SUT-<n>, design-unit ids are taken from the SWDD when present and otherwise generated as SWDD-<n>. digits pads the number; start is the first number issued.
_comment_methods: Allowed values for the test-method and design-method columns of the case template. The first entry of each list is the default.
design_method_text: 基于需求分析、等价类、边界值
_comment_priority: SWDD Priority = Complexity x Importance (1..25) mapped to the H/M/L column. Boundaries are inclusive lower bounds.
_comment_fixed_text: Boilerplate columns. Keep them aligned with the wording your reviewers expect.
verdict_default: 执行测试该用例，实际输出值与期望值一致，覆盖分支与目标一致
_comment_static: SWE.4-A04 static verification. cyclomatic_max mirrors the process KPI.
_comment_coverage_evidence: 由 build_evidence.py 生成的证据报告，报告的证据列引用它。不要指向 Ceedling gcov 插件的默认报告：它按 :paths :source 过滤，而整 TU 测法下被测文件不在该路径上，那份报告必然是空的（0/0）。
_comment_templates: Company templates cloned to produce the deliverables. Paths are relative to the project root.

templates.case: 单元测试/AU-QR-R&D-046-软件单元测试用例模板Software_Unit_Test_Case_Template_V1.0.xls
templates.report: 单元测试/AU-QR-R&D-048-软件单元测试报告Software_Unit_Test_Report_V1.0.xlsx
templates.trace: 单元测试/AU-QR-R&D-038-软件单元测试追溯矩阵Software Unit Test Traceability Matrix.xlsx

_comment_tools: 可选：钉住产出本次结果的工具路径，受控交付物需要记录到底是哪套工具链跑的。工具已安装但不在 PATH 上时必须填写 —— Ceedling 是 Ruby gem 的 shim，其 bin 目录常不在系统 PATH 上。键名取 gcovr / gcc / ceedling / cppcheck。
